dedupe_keys.name: zindi inundata reported south african flood locations 1981 2023 with chirps daily rainfall and composite imagery for flood day detection

description: Inundata: Mapping Floods in South Africa was a Zindi challenge (November 2024 to February 2025) on identifying the day an urban flash flood happened. Contents: reported flood locations in South Africa from 1981 to 2023, each paired with daily CHIRPS precipitation aggregated within a 5 km radius over a 730-day window, and composite cloud-free earth observation images of the areas; the set is deliberately imbalanced, with some event windows containing one flood day and others none, and actual dates are hidden (days are linear steps). Producer: Zindi challenge. Coverage: South Africa, 1981 to 2023. Format and access: Train.csv, Test.csv, composite_images.npz and a starter notebook from Zindi after joining. Licence: challenge data may be accessed, used and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 according to the challenge rules. Caveats: flood reports are sparse and many urban floods were under-reported; hidden dates prevent linking to external data without the original event list. Simulation uses: training flood occurrence models and building event archives for urban drainage and road flood exposure studies. Related records: data-caravan-global-large-sample-hydrology.
